subject: [PATCH RFC v4 12/12] selftests/mm: add a slow-GUP content and COW test for mTHP

2026-07-24.patch_summary: This patch adds a new test, mthp_gup_cow_test, to the Linux kernel selftests suite. The test checks that the slow get_user_pages() path correctly handles PTE-mapped large folios (mTHP) and copy-on-write (COW) operations. It does this by forcing 64kB-only mTHP, writing a distinct pattern to each page, pinning the region on the slow path, and comparing the copied contents against the original pattern. The test covers read pins, write pins, and COW after fork(), and also reports how many pages are in contiguous large-folio runs. This patch addresses a potential issue where mis-batched mTHP runs could return incorrect pages or stale COW copies.
